description: Runnable example for `magere pack-goz1`: packs the mini Grok dissect-manifest fixture into a GOZ1 shell. The source manifest is a Grok-1 MoE checkpoint so the model identity recorded in the emitted manifest matches the fixture's tensor table. Run from the repository root; writes to the repo-relative artifacts/packs/ (gitignored), so it works as-is without root or a writable /packs.
